heading: Career and credentials
intro: Where I've built, what I work with, and the recognition the work has earned.

timeline.title: Full Stack Developer & Founder
timeline.summary: Running my own software studio, delivering web and app products, automation tools and custom software for clients end to end: scoping, building, deploying and supporting.

timeline.title: Project Engineer, Electronic System Development
points: Implemented GNSS-IMU sensor integration for accurate positioning and orientation of autonomous systems.
Developed LoRa-based long-range wireless data transmission between an ocean surface vehicle and its shore station.
Built artificial-potential-field obstacle avoidance simulation using ROS in Gazebo.
Programmed Raspberry Pi and Arduino Mega for real-time sensor acquisition and processing.

timeline.title: Research Engineer, Team Lead
points: Led a team developing a computer-vision prediction system using OpenCV and machine-learning models.
Evaluated SVM, Random Forest and CNN architectures; contributed to a research paper draft on AI-based environmental sensing.

timeline.title: B.E. Electronics & Communication Engineering
timeline.summary: Graduated with a CGPA of 7.5/10 and no arrears, alongside national hackathons, conference presentations and a continuous stream of build projects.
